# 507. Perfect Number

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def checkPerfectNumber(self, num):
        """
        :type num: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        cur_sum = 0
        for i in range(1, int(sqrt(num)) + 1):
            if num % i == 0:
                cur_sum += i
                cur_sum += num / i
        cur_sum -= num
        if sqrt(num).is_integer():
            cur_sum -= int(sqrt(num))
        return cur_sum == num
```
